name: Metamagic Rod, Sickening
body:
Aura strong (no school); CL 17th; Weight 5 lbs.

Price varies by specific type:

Lesser sickening metamagic rod 9,000 gp
Sickening metamagic rod 32,500 gp
Greater sickening metamagic rod 73,000 gp

DESCRIPTION

The wielder can cast up to three spells per day that sicken affected creatures as though using the Sickening Spell feat.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Rod, Sickening Spell

Cost varies by specific type:

Lesser sickening metamagic rod 4,500 gp
Sickening metamagic rod 16,250 gp
Greater sickening metamagic rod 36,500 gp
